entities.note: 10x10 picture at rows 3-12, cols 3-12 (top-left panel): rows 3-7 black(0), rows 8-12 white(15); the canvas must be made equal to it
10x10 black square at rows 34-43, cols 27-36 in the middle of the screen; gets painted by pours

14x9 box with a red(2) border and an interior of the current paint colour (white 15 at start) at rows 24-32, cols 25-38, i.e. the TOP slot of a ring of 8 slots around the canvas; at the 4 corner slots it becomes a 17x17 diagonal wedge
palette: 5x5 yellow(4)-bordered squares at rows 2-6 with a 3x3 centre of the paint colour: black(0) at cols 35-39, white(15) at cols 41-45
5x1 black bar at row 7 under the currently selected swatch (cols 41-45 under white at start)
yellow 2-px L frame (cols 16-17 rows 0-17, rows 16-17 cols 0-17) around the target panel and a green(3) strip across the top (rows 0-8, cols 18-63) behind the palette
row 63: yellow(4) = remaining actions (64 px = 100 actions), eaten from the RIGHT into background colour 5

rules.note: basket moves UP one slot on the 3x3 ring around the canvas (top row / middle row / bottom row); the ring's centre is forbidden; costs 1 action
basket moves DOWN one slot on the ring
basket moves LEFT one slot on the ring
basket moves RIGHT one slot on the ring; at a corner slot the basket is redrawn as a diagonal wedge
a move off the ring (already in the top row) or into the centre of the ring is ignored but still costs 1 action (same for ACTION2/3/4)

pour: the basket lunges 7 px at the canvas and fills the canvas HALF nearest to it with the basket colour (top slot -> rows 0-4, bottom -> rows 5-9, left -> cols 0-4, right -> cols 5-9); a corner (wedge) basket fills the triangle on its side of the diagonal; overpainting allowed; win checked after each pour; costs 1 action
the basket interior takes the swatch's centre colour and the black marker moves under that swatch; costs 1 action
marker jumps to sit under the clicked swatch
clicking the canvas, basket, target or empty space does nothing but costs 1 action

goal.note: the canvas must equal the target picture (the two diagonals are never compared): rows 5-9 white, rows 0-4 black; minimal: ACTION4, ACTION2, ACTION2, ACTION3, ACTION5 (basket to the bottom slot, pour white)
